head: 35e0f20b93eaba7970dd97d0424c5666654ce7a9
conclusion: Project identity no longer hashes st.dev (path, real git common dir, inode, birth time); every caller goes through learningIdentity. Stale knowledge never fails a build: it runs without it, the brief says it was not applied, and an approver applies it forward from the Knowledge page or toolroll knowledge apply as a new revision, recorded in an append-only project_identity_carry table. Rows under the old formula with the current st.dev carry over silently; a repo recreated at the same path still asks.
changes: project-learning.ts: identityOf/legacyIdentityOf, carryProject, reconcileIdentity, acceptedIdentities; learning checks accept carried identities, writes use the current one.
project-knowledge.ts: stale knowledge is shown for review only, never applied; applySavedKnowledge (refuses the lead); snapshots of stale builds are stored under the current identity.
project-skills.ts, coding-handoff.ts, coding-context.ts accept carried identities; a skills freeze proceeds without skills saved under an un-carried identity.

Console: one notice, saved knowledge in a disclosure, Apply saved knowledge button (action=apply, CSRF, approver). CLI: knowledge apply in knowledge-cli.ts, operate.ts and surface.ts (operator audience).
Chat: conversationKnowledge returns the stale notice with the Knowledge page path and the CLI command instead of throwing.
verification: npx vitest run on project-learning, project-knowledge, project-skills, coding-context, project-delete, operate and pull-request-flow test files: all pass.
followUps: Chat gap: chat cannot apply stale knowledge itself; it points to the Knowledge page and the CLI command.
Skills saved under an un-carried identity still raise an error on the Skills page; applying knowledge records the carry, which clears it.
verifyCodingContext has no store, so it accepts only the current or same-volume legacy identity, not approver carries.
The shared node_modules was unreadable from this worktree, so I ran a private npm install here (package files unchanged).
No desktop or phone screenshots were taken of the new Knowledge notice. The HTTP test checks the markup only.
The stuck install recovers only after this build is deployed.
